news_items.headline: Anthony Volpe denies 'B.S.' report that he refused to play 2B
news_items.description: Yankees shortstop Anthony Volpe strongly denied a report that he refused to play second base earlier this season, saying he was caught "off guard" by the since-retracted report, which he called "B.S."
